home-loads.name: Landing page loads
home-loads.description: Versiona landing renders the 'El Git de tus documentos' headline, dual CTA (public comparator + free signup with the 14-day Pro trial), how-it-works, honest features/tech sections, pricing preview, FAQ and the public header/footer

auth-sign-in-form.name: Sign-in form display and interaction
auth-sign-in-form.description: Sign-in renders email/password and recovery controls. A successful first factor for an account with TOTP enabled replaces that form with the TOTP challenge; no session is created until the code succeeds.

auth-sign-up-form.name: Sign-up form display and validation
auth-sign-up-form.description: Sign-up validates password confirmation and displays configured server password-policy errors without leaving the form. A Google login that legitimately returns a TOTP challenge replaces this form with the same second-factor form; a successful code lands on onboarding.

auth-login-invalid.name: Invalid credentials are rejected
auth-login-invalid.description: Wrong credentials or an inactive account show an error and do not create a session. Invalid Google claims are rejected server-side; real Google OAuth remains an explicit backend/unit-only exemption.

auth-protected-redirect.name: Protected routes redirect anonymous users
auth-protected-redirect.description: Visiting a protected route without a session redirects to sign-in

auth-forgot-password-form.name: Password recovery form
auth-forgot-password-form.description: Recovery renders the two-step code + reset form. A password-policy rejection keeps the form and recovery code usable for a valid retry.

auth-sign-in-success.name: Sign-in happy path with a real session
auth-sign-in-success.description: Valid password credentials for an account without TOTP create a real session and land on /projects directly. The TOTP completion branch belongs to A3.
auth-sign-in-success.knownGaps: Closed in It1 by the storageState harness + session spec

auth-sign-out.name: Sign out ends the session
auth-sign-out.description: Authenticated user presses Salir; cookies are cleared and protected routes redirect again
auth-sign-out.knownGaps: Closed in It1 by the session spec

auth-admin-login-handoff.name: Django admin impersonation handoff
auth-admin-login-handoff.description: /admin-login consumes access/refresh/redirect query params, stores tokens and redirects. Declared exempt from E2E credit: the click that starts this handoff happens inside the Django admin, a separate app outside this suite, so no spec can drive it through the UI. The handoff logic itself is covered at the unit layer by frontend/app/admin-login/__tests__/page.test.tsx; the two smoke specs in e2e/auth/admin-login.spec.ts still run, they just no longer buy coverage credit

help-manual-browse.name: Browse the interactive help
help-manual-browse.description: /manual renders Versiona help sections and fuzzy search finds a process

a1-onboarding-wow.name: A1 - Sign-up and first wow moment
a1-onboarding-wow.description: New user signs up, names their org, the sample project seeds, and they see a working comparison in under 5 minutes without uploading anything (docs/plan/01 A1). If the seed job fails server-side (e.g. storage unavailable mid-seed), the form shows a retryable error rather than stranding the user (verified at the E2E layer by scenario A1-E01), and the wizard stays 'pending' with no half-seeded project left behind (verified at the backend layer by backend/orgs/tests/test_onboarding.py:87-120, since an E2E run that mocks the POST never reaches the seed job)

a2-invite-team.name: A2 - Invite the team and assign roles
a2-invite-team.description: Admin invites an email with a role; invitee accepts and lands directly on the project. Member and pending-invitation rows remain readable with long addresses in the project settings view (docs/plan/01 A2)

b1-create-project.name: B1 - Create a project in 30 seconds
b1-create-project.description: Member creates a project with name only and lands on the empty project with the upload dropzone (docs/plan/01 B1)

b2-projects-board.name: B2 - Projects board with states, filters and search
b2-projects-board.description: Board shows derived states, filters by state and searches by name and content; its local controls and complete card text remain usable across the supported project-module viewports (docs/plan/01 B2)

b3-project-settings.name: B3 - Edit project configuration (never retroactive)
b3-project-settings.description: Admin edits checklist/section owners/approval rules creating a new config version, including an editable five-column checklist that remains usable in portrait tablet (docs/plan/01 B3)

c1-upload-first.name: C1 - Upload the first document
c1-upload-first.description: Editor drags a PDF; analysis indexes sections and version 1 shows its traffic light (docs/plan/01 C1) The per-user upload-intent quota is 20/hour: when it is exhausted, the request shows a retryable 429 without issuing another signed URL; an intent issued before exhaustion can still be completed.

c2-upload-version.name: C2 - Upload a new version (the commit)
c2-upload-version.description: Editor uploads a re-delivery with a message; within seconds sees what changed, check deltas and affected seals (docs/plan/01 C2) The per-user upload-intent quota is 20/hour: when it is exhausted, the request shows a retryable 429 without issuing another signed URL; an intent issued before exhaustion can still be completed. At 412x915 the editor taps 'Editar mensaje' beside a long draft message (no longer clipped by a truncated line), saves the corrected text and sees it in the timeline; the upload modal fields are 16 px and its buttons, the version checkboxes and 'Comparar seleccionadas' are 44 px touch targets that open the comparison with '2 modificadas, 1 eliminada, 1 agregada', without horizontal page scroll.

c3-history.name: C3 - Browse the version history
c3-history.description: Timeline shows author/date/message per version, downloads via signed URL and jumps to comparison (docs/plan/01 C3). At 412x915 each version message wraps in full instead of being truncated, and the view/download/delete actions take their own row as 44 px touch targets; the 412 px timeline contract is exercised by the C2 spec (C2-R01, C2-R02).

d1-request-review.name: D1 - Request a review (the pull request)
d1-request-review.description: Author opens a review request; reviewers are assigned from section owners and see it in their inbox (docs/plan/01 D1)

d2-assisted-review.name: D2 - Review with assistance (already reviewed by you)
d2-assisted-review.description: Reviewer sees traffic light and change summary first, jumps to changed sections, unchanged-since-my-seal sections are marked (docs/plan/01 D2)

d3-anchored-observations.name: D3 - Anchored observations with progressive reading
d3-anchored-observations.description: Reviewer or admin creates an anchored thread; editor replies; the author or an admin resolves it, and the author reopens it under I14. The version viewer loads thread summaries in 25-item pages, then loads replies, anchor history, long text and anchor coordinates only when the person explicitly requests each part. A history link keeps a selected thread reachable beyond the first page. Reading failures provide retry controls and stale responses are discarded when version or status filter changes.

d4-seal-approve.name: D4 - Approve with a seal
d4-seal-approve.description: Reviewer seals in one click; with all required seals the version freezes as approved (docs/plan/01 D4)

d5-selective-invalidation.name: D5 - Re-delivery and selective invalidation (the jewel)
d5-selective-invalidation.description: Re-delivery preserves inherited seals across three versions, invalidates changed coverage, and requires coordinator confirmation for verified degraded analysis; reviewers are notified only after final invalidation.

e1-compare.name: E1 - Compare any two versions (star screen)
e1-compare.description: Side-by-side with highlights, modified-section list matching the fixture truth table, and summary view (docs/plan/01 E1). At 412x915 the save, next-change and view-tab controls wrap below the title as 44 px targets without horizontal page scroll, and tapping 'Resumen' shows 2 modified, 1 removed and 1 added; at every reference width the selected section shows its full name (e.g. '3. OBLIGACIONES DEL CONTRATISTA' in the 260 px side column from 1195x835) instead of a truncated one.

e3-configurable-checks.name: E3 - Configure and run checks (traffic light with evidence)
e3-configurable-checks.description: Admin adds a check; next version runs it and shows evidence navigable to the page (docs/plan/01 E3)

f1-billing.name: F1 - Plan limits and upgrade path (contact - no online payment)
f1-billing.description: Free org hits a plan limit (402 + upgrade flag) and gets the reusable upgrade dialog linking to /precios; Pro beyond the trial is activated by contact
f1-billing.knownGaps: Wompi/online checkout not shipped - upgrade is manual via hola@versiona.app; every new signup auto-starts a 14-day Pro trial

c4-delete-draft.name: C4 - Delete a draft version (trash + restore)
c4-delete-draft.description: Latest draft version goes to the trash with two-step confirmation, shows a tombstone and can be restored (docs/audit/03 C4). A rejected delete (e.g. the 409 'Solo la última versión del documento puede eliminarse') surfaces the backend's message via toast instead of closing the dialog silently — fixed 2026-08-02 (PR #9) after VersionTimeline was found swallowing the refusal; pinned by the C4-E02 spec assertion

a3-account-security.name: A3 - 2FA and active sessions
a3-account-security.description: TOTP enrolment, active-session revocation, and completion of a challenge issued after password or validated Google first-factor login. A malformed, expired, disabled, deleted, or inactive-user challenge returns 401 and creates no session. Google OAuth itself remains exempt from real E2E because it depends on the external provider.

e2-saved-comparisons.name: E2 - Saved comparisons
e2-saved-comparisons.description: Save a comparison with a name, list it per project, share an internal link (docs/audit/03 E2)

f2-usage-panel.name: F2 - Usage panel and preventive warnings
f2-usage-panel.description: Usage vs plan limits with warnings at 80%, trial status line, reachable from the authed header (Plan y uso) and settings; upgrade CTA links to /precios with a contact fallback

e4-constancia.name: E4 - Exportable certificate
e4-constancia.description: Issue and download the validity certificate PDF of an approved version (docs/audit/03 E4). The `error` class was removed on 2026-08-02 because neither issuance DomainError is reachable through the UI: the `issue-certificate` button only renders when `canIssue && isApproved` (frontend/components/certificates/CertificatePanel.tsx:75) and the whole panel returns null when `!isApproved && rows.length === 0` (:70), so E4-E01 'unapproved version' can never be clicked; E4-E02 'tampered signature' requires corrupting a stored seal signature directly in the DB. Both remain covered at the backend layer (backend/reviews/tests/test_certificates.py:70-97). Re-declare `error` here if the UI ever grows an affordance that can surface a failed issuance

master-e2e-journey.name: M1 - Master end-to-end journey
master-e2e-journey.description: Sign-up to certificate export in 16 UI-only steps (docs/audit/03 SS7)

b4-archive-delete.name: B4 - Archive or delete a project
b4-archive-delete.description: Archiving locks writes; deletion needs the exact name, lands in the org trash and is restorable; sealed projects only archive (T4) (docs/audit/03 B4)

public-pricing.name: Public pricing page
public-pricing.description: /precios renders the 3-plan catalog from GET /api/public/plans/ (silent static fallback), COP prices, comparison table, trial badge on Pro and honest CTAs (signup / contact - no online checkout)

trial-visibility.name: Trial banner visibility
trial-visibility.description: Fresh signup auto-starts the 14-day Pro trial; the authed app shows a dismissable banner with days left linking to /precios and the usage panel shows the trial line

public-compare.name: Anonymous public PDF comparison
public-compare.description: Visitor compares two PDFs on /comparar without an account (10MB/100-page caps, no OCR), sees the truth-table result on a shareable 24h page and the persistent signup CTA A current result-route poll that fails, expires or times out renders an alert and lets the visitor start a new comparison; an obsolete prior poll is discarded by public-compare-lifecycle.

f3-org-audit.name: F3 - Org audit log with CSV export
f3-org-audit.description: Owner/admin browses the organization audit log at /org/audit (type/actor filters, audit-list) and exports it as CSV; non-admins get the administration-view notice (shipped It7, spec added 2026-07-22)

layout-public-navigation.name: Public navigation at every reference width
layout-public-navigation.description: The public menu opens in one interaction on phone and portrait tablet; desktop navigation exposes the same links and actions. Navigation, theme and language remain usable; Escape and outside click close the menu and restore focus.

layout-authenticated-navigation.name: Authenticated navigation at every reference width
layout-authenticated-navigation.description: Signed-in navigation preserves link order and role-gated trash access at all five reference widths. The compact menu, notification dropdown and sign-out remain operable without horizontal scrolling.

public-compare-lifecycle.name: Public comparison loading follows the current page
public-compare-lifecycle.description: Leaving an in-progress comparison and opening a new comparison cancels the old polling lifecycle. Late responses from the previous page cannot replace the current comparison result. Out-of-order HTTP errors and timer cancellation are also verified at the store unit layer.
